thread.text:
Today: Incline bench ran true to plan — 40kg×10 warm-up, 70kg×6, 6, 6, then 50kg×12 back-off. That's an improvement on 11-16's 5, 5, 5 at the same load, still short of the 8s needed for 72.5kg. Pull-ups in slot 2: +10kg×8, 7, then bodyweight×7 — the first set ticked up from last time's 7. Reverse fly held 47.5kg across all three sets at 10, 10, 10, cleaner than 11-16 when the third set dropped to 42.5kg. Lateral raise: 8kg×17, 17, 15 — both working sets up from 15 to 17, and the failure set landed at 15, same ceiling as every Monday since September. Triceps pull repeated 10kg×12, 12, 12. Chest fly came in at 67.5kg×12, 10, 10, a step up from the prescribed 65kg.

Sleep: 7h09 the night before, HRV 125, 47bpm asleep, against a week average of 7h16 and HRV 123. No normal yet to measure against, and nothing here looks tied to today's numbers.

Trend: One Handed Triceps Pull has now hit 12, 12, 12 on both 11-16 and today — two sessions at the top of the band, so the rule fires: 12.5kg next time it's in rotation. Lateral raise is edging toward the 9kg mark (17+ on the first two is there) but the failure set still caps at 15, unchanged for four sessions running. Reverse fly looks more settled at 47.5kg than it did on 11-16.

Next session: Upper B, Thu 26 Nov. Deadlift steps to 82.5kg for 3×5. Pull-ups stay slot 2, bodyweight, two short of failure. Iso-Lateral Row gets its first run at 42.5kg since the machine was taken on 11-19 — if it's taken again, seated cable row at 47kg. Cable curl moves to 11.25kg.

Question: the chest fly jump to 67.5kg wasn't earned by the rule — 11-16 was 10, 10, 10 at 65kg, not 12s across the board. Did you just feel strong and push it, or was there a reason to skip ahead?
i didn’t realise it was 67.5kg, i thought it was only 65kg

Fair enough — that explains it, not a jump you meant to make. Worth treating it as 65kg×12, 10, 10 for progression purposes, same as 11-16's top-of-band set pattern rather than a new load. Keep it at 65kg next time in rotation and check the plates before you load up, since the rule only fires off two genuine sessions at 12s across all three.
